d3938b34acbc1f28.en: Check the new tree separately; permission for Д-14 and Д-15 does not establish a basis for Д-16. This is a new circumstance or incomplete confirmation; the previous conclusion does not replace checking it.
d3938b34acbc1f28.zh: 单独核查新涉及的树木；针对Д-14和Д-15的许可不能证明处理Д-16具有依据。这属于新情况或确认不完整，先前结论不能代替对此进行核查。

12ca22b4d8bca7ce.en: A week later, the resident reports the removal of Д-16. That number is absent from the previous extract.
12ca22b4d8bca7ce.zh: 一周后，居民报告Д-16被清除。此前的摘录中没有这个编号。

43597b7fc0cdbcbe.en: Check the new tree separately; permission for Д-14 and Д-15 does not establish a basis for Д-16.
43597b7fc0cdbcbe.zh: 单独核查新涉及的树木；针对Д-14和Д-15的许可不能证明处理Д-16具有依据。

f43291600f3ca584.en: Reply that the legality of work in the courtyard has already been established.
f43291600f3ca584.zh: 回复称，院内作业的合法性已经得到确认。

5a589111a76ad5ec.en: Change the number in the old permit without a decision by the authorised authority.
5a589111a76ad5ec.zh: 未经授权机关决定，修改旧许可中的编号。

88872b255f14ada0.en: Two trees near the building were cut down. Nobody showed me a permit, so I am sure they worked without one. The authority has sent documents; please help me understand them.
88872b255f14ada0.zh: 住宅附近有两棵树被砍了。没人向我出示许可，所以我确信他们没有许可就施工。机关发来了文件，请帮我弄清楚。

33e621bb2b27779e.en: Treat the applicant's lack of a permit as proof that no permit exists.
33e621bb2b27779e.zh: 将申请人没有许可视为许可本身不存在的证据。

2d65e78664785148.en: Check only the document number, without comparing the plot, objects and types of work.
2d65e78664785148.zh: 只检查文件编号，不比对地块、对象及作业类型。

a0f29ca52e0562c7.en: Д-14 and Д-15. Those numbers appear in my location card and on the attached plan.
a0f29ca52e0562c7.zh: Д-14和Д-15。我的地点记录卡及所附平面图中都有这两个编号。

acea18a28150b534.en: The objects can be matched unambiguously.
acea18a28150b534.zh: 可以明确对应这些对象。

64a6b00fdb4bf395.en: How are the trees labelled on the plan?
64a6b00fdb4bf395.zh: 平面图上如何标记这些树木？

0e5419f4fd7d97ce.en: Yes. The training extract confirms authenticity, validity on the date and precisely these numbers, with the work type stated as “removal”.
0e5419f4fd7d97ce.zh: 是的。教学摘录确认了真实性、当日有效性，且明确列出这些编号，作业类型为“清除”。

ae22d9fdcf14c910.en: The check goes beyond the paper presented by the contractor.
ae22d9fdcf14c910.zh: 核查不只限于承包商出示的纸张。

8c10b45cfa1a382b.en: Has the permit been verified with the authorised authority?
8c10b45cfa1a382b.zh: 是否已向授权机关核实许可？

00fdd2b55f561fbb.en: They concern the same trees; the case conditions establish no departures from the authorised work.
00fdd2b55f561fbb.zh: 它们涉及同一批树木；题设未认定作业偏离许可范围。

f93cf96647ffd194.en: The applicant's lack of a copy cannot displace a confirmed fact.
f93cf96647ffd194.zh: 不能以申请人没有副本来替代已确认事实。

7eae32a0c9b73dcb.en: Is there a completion report and an assessment?
7eae32a0c9b73dcb.zh: 是否有作业完成记录及评估结论？

05a85e0d0017ced4.en: For now, I want an explanation of the basis. The subsequent restoration procedure is stated separately.
05a85e0d0017ced4.zh: 目前我想了解依据。后续恢复程序已另行说明。

a55095c7508261e8.en: The response must cover the specific question and the limits of the check.
a55095c7508261e8.zh: 回复必须涵盖具体问题及核查范围。

cfc235509aacdb3d.en: Are there any separate new questions?
cfc235509aacdb3d.zh: 是否还有独立的新问题？

f9d64a2d6d538057.en: Specialist in the unit handling submissions about urban landscaping
f9d64a2d6d538057.zh: 城市绿化来函办理部门工作人员

41e799448f2f36ab.en: Prepare a response based on the verified set of documents for the specific objects; new objects require a separate assessment.
41e799448f2f36ab.zh: 依据针对具体对象的经核实材料准备回复；新对象需要单独评估。

f19358c12d827a1b.en: Declare the work unlawful because the resident did not personally attach a copy of the permit.
f19358c12d827a1b.zh: 因居民本人未附许可副本，就宣布作业违法。

82c3deb70f117b13.en: Treat the matching list of trees as confirmation of any work on neighbouring plots.
82c3deb70f117b13.zh: 将树木清单相符视为对邻近地块任何作业的确认。

d1bcd0d5adf688c2.en: In the original version, the permit concerned another location. Here it is confirmed for the relevant trees, so the substantive response must change.
d1bcd0d5adf688c2.zh: 在原版本中，许可涉及另一个地点。本案已确认许可适用于相关树木，因此实质回复必须改变。

e2f78ba35c6b8821.en: Assistant: “The conclusion about the two named trees does not confirm permission to remove a third.”
e2f78ba35c6b8821.zh: 助手：“针对指定两棵树的结论，并不能确认获准清除第三棵树。”

b654b6f2b7288ebe.en: Compare the type of authorised work with the work actually performed
b654b6f2b7288ebe.zh: 比对许可作业类型与实际完成的作业类型

b8c15824824fd833.en: Prepare to establish whether other valid grounds exist for Д-22
b8c15824824fd833.zh: 准备查明是否存在针对Д-22的其他有效依据

b7786dfb3d85bed0.en: Forward the confirmed discrepancy to the authorised unit for assessment
b7786dfb3d85bed0.zh: 将已确认的差异转交授权部门评估

8936e82b284cc513.en: Inform the applicant of the established discrepancy without a premature accusation
8936e82b284cc513.zh: 向申请人告知已查明的差异，不作过早指控

ea25005c74d46e19.en: Check that the response concerns Д-22 and the full type of work
ea25005c74d46e19.zh: 核查回复是否针对Д-22及完整的作业类型

e43e6f4c0ff9e875.en: Close the submission merely because some document exists
e43e6f4c0ff9e875.zh: 只因存在某份文件就结束来函办理

45f49f0d8c2a1b0c.en: Impose a sanction on behalf of the reception office before considering the circumstances
45f49f0d8c2a1b0c.zh: 在审查情况前以接待处名义施加处罚

f728d51c06611e00.en: Protection of the stock of green spaces includes measures to preserve and develop it; regulation is carried out in accordance with legislation. The article is not a ready-made permit to remove any tree and does not establish a single set of documents for all territories.
f728d51c06611e00.zh: 城市绿化资源保护包括保存与发展措施，其管理依照法律进行。该条并非清除任何树木的现成许可，也未为所有地区规定统一的文件组合。

79d73027bf777027.en: Impose a sanction on behalf of the reception office before considering the circumstances: the action exceeds the stated authority or creates an unjustified risk.
79d73027bf777027.zh: 在审查情况前以接待处名义施加处罚：该行为超出规定权限，或造成不合理风险。

2a93cf650e484598.en: The valid document for Д-22 permits sanitary pruning of the specified branches. Removal of the trunk is not included in its scope. The issuing procedure is defined by the training materials, not generalised to all of Russia.
2a93cf650e484598.zh: 针对Д-22的有效文件允许对指定树枝进行卫生性修剪，其范围不包括清除树干。签发程序由教学材料规定，并非将其概括为适用于全俄罗斯。

cdd0e1626b5706c6.en: An authorised specialist recorded the removal of the trunk of Д-22. The number and plot match. The set contains no information about an additional basis; its existence must be checked.
cdd0e1626b5706c6.zh: 授权专业人员记录了Д-22树干被清除的情况。编号与地块相符。材料中没有额外依据的信息，必须核查其是否存在。

a444c9563d05d5f6.en: Removal is permitted for Д-23 at another location. That document does not extend the scope for Д-22.
a444c9563d05d5f6.zh: 另一地点的Д-23获准清除。该文件不会扩大Д-22的许可范围。

6d337dfbabb8136f.en: The type of work actually carried out is not covered by the supplied basis; other grounds and circumstances must be checked within the relevant authority. In the original version, the plot did not match. Here the plot and tree match, and the decisive difference is between the authorised and actual type of work.
6d337dfbabb8136f.zh: 实际完成的作业类型不在所提供依据的范围内；须由相应职权主体核查其他依据及情况。原版本中地块不符。本案地块与树木均相符，关键区别在于许可作业类型与实际作业类型。

8a68cea18830ff84.en: The type of work actually carried out is not covered by the supplied basis; other grounds and circumstances must be checked within the relevant authority.
8a68cea18830ff84.zh: 实际完成的作业类型不在所提供依据的范围内；须由相应职权主体核查其他依据及情况。

661dfa4946af5315.en: Matching the tree number is enough: any document permits any type of work.
661dfa4946af5315.zh: 树木编号相符就足够了：任何文件都允许任何类型的作业。

4b15bfeaba46050b.en: The reception office can immediately fine the culprit without checking other grounds.
4b15bfeaba46050b.zh: 接待处可以不查明其他依据就立即对责任人罚款。

7a55477984297540.en: Keep the issue concerning Д-22 under follow-up and verify the appropriate basis specifically for it. This is a new circumstance or incomplete confirmation; the previous conclusion does not replace checking it.
7a55477984297540.zh: 继续跟踪Д-22的问题，并核查确实针对它的适当依据。这属于新情况或确认不完整，先前结论不能代替对此进行核查。

a78941560eede2c6.en: The response includes an additional removal permit for Д-23, not Д-22.
a78941560eede2c6.zh: 回复附上了针对Д-23而非Д-22的额外清除许可。

f89591c0214538bd.en: Keep the issue concerning Д-22 under follow-up and verify the appropriate basis specifically for it.
f89591c0214538bd.zh: 继续跟踪Д-22的问题，并核查确实针对它的适当依据。

0d0c7dc0bdba73cb.en: Accept any removal permit as justification for the work.
0d0c7dc0bdba73cb.zh: 接受任何清除许可作为这些作业的正当依据。

267cc7f69a7ac8e4.en: Independently add Д-22 to the document presented.
267cc7f69a7ac8e4.zh: 自行将Д-22写入所出示的文件。

5146cf32d5860c6c.en: Find the rule: Environmental protection: green spaces. Specify the act's details and article, then determine how it applies.
5146cf32d5860c6c.zh: 查找规范：环境保护——绿化资源。注明法律文件信息及条款，然后确定其适用方式。

5028cd821dd971bb.en: The contractor is showing a permit for work on a tree. But it says branch pruning, while only a stump is left on site. Does any document like that authorise everything?
5028cd821dd971bb.zh: 承包商出示了对树木作业的许可。但上面写的是修剪树枝，现场却只剩下树桩。难道任何这样的文件都能允许一切作业吗？

451fdd8011bb9a1c.en: Determine whether the work is permissible from a matching tree number, without checking its type.
451fdd8011bb9a1c.zh: 仅凭树木编号相符判断作业是否获准，不核查作业类型。

ed2ac1abdc0dbe4e.en: Treat any tree-care document as permission to remove the trunk.
ed2ac1abdc0dbe4e.zh: 将任何树木养护文件视为清除树干的许可。

f91a7d5dfcb85bd2.en: Yes, tree Д-22 and the plot are identified consistently.
f91a7d5dfcb85bd2.zh: 是的，树木Д-22及地块的标注一致。

2fd6ea55dfa1a62b.en: The difference concerns the type of work, not the address.
2fd6ea55dfa1a62b.zh: 差异在于作业类型，而非地址。

3c1dc3e20203415c.en: Sanitary pruning of specified branches; tree removal is not in the document.
3c1dc3e20203415c.zh: 对指定树枝进行卫生性修剪；文件中没有清除树木的内容。

7649b15218b3ebb1.en: The limits of the authorising basis are stated explicitly in the materials.
7649b15218b3ebb1.zh: 材料明确规定了依据的适用范围。

86231e2583e71964.en: What type of work is permitted?

982838d39dc6af09.en: A specialist prepared a card: the trunk of Д-22 was removed and the stump remains.
982838d39dc6af09.zh: 专业人员制作了记录卡：Д-22的树干已被清除，留下树桩。

5b84cbf3e89d7d44.en: The conclusion is not based solely on an amateur photograph's angle.
5b84cbf3e89d7d44.zh: 结论不只是基于非专业照片的拍摄角度。

a642122b0a979d92.en: There is none in the available set; the authorised department must be asked whether another basis existed.
a642122b0a979d92.zh: 现有材料中没有；需要向授权部门查明是否存在其他依据。

f29cbcb2addc93da.en: The officer must not decide guilt and a sanction in advance.
f29cbcb2addc93da.zh: 工作人员不得事先认定责任及处罚。

dd1d5a1e2d13fd12.en: Is there a confirmed supplement to the permit?
dd1d5a1e2d13fd12.zh: 是否有经确认的许可补充文件？

50b96df5ae04e89c.en: Prepare for the authorised unit to check the discrepancy concerning the object and type of work; do not substitute for its legal assessment.
50b96df5ae04e89c.zh: 安排授权部门核查对象与作业类型方面的差异；不代替其进行法律评估。

638a32488ccf31b2.en: Confirm the lawfulness of removal solely on the basis of a sanitary pruning document.
638a32488ccf31b2.zh: 仅依据卫生性修剪文件，就确认清除作业合法。

b25fdc99223ebf3e.en: Impose a sanction by a reception-office letter without checking additional grounds and authority.
b25fdc99223ebf3e.zh: 未核查其他依据及权限，就以接待处信件施加处罚。

e4f9b62feaca14e5.en: Pruning was permitted; the trunk was removed
e4f9b62feaca14e5.zh: 获准修枝，却清除了树干

4245097d7332a277.en: In the original version, the plot did not match. Here the plot and tree match, and the decisive difference is between the authorised and actual type of work.
4245097d7332a277.zh: 原版本中地块不符。本案地块与树木均相符，关键区别在于许可作业类型与实际作业类型。

8cac3b13b385ccd6.en: Assistant: “A matching address is sufficient for legality; the type of work in the permit is irrelevant.”
8cac3b13b385ccd6.zh: 助手：“地址相符就足以证明合法，许可中的作业类型无关紧要。”

3324399e3704777f.en: Check all the material, including any annexes
3324399e3704777f.zh: 检查全部材料，包括可能存在的附件

43247900d343a5c5.en: Record that no identifiable subject can be established, without judging the author's views
43247900d343a5c5.zh: 记录无法确定具体事项，不评价作者的观点

92e2d447073ec1d6.en: Prepare the required notice on the correct basis
92e2d447073ec1d6.zh: 依据正确事由准备规定通知

f9cbc3239c096133.en: Explain the need to state a specific question, without requiring legal terminology
f9cbc3239c096133.zh: 说明需要提出具体问题，但不要求使用法律术语

2b99d603e0119bb5.en: Retain confirmation that the notice was sent and take account of any clarification
2b99d603e0119bb5.zh: 保留通知发送确认，并考虑可能的补充说明

a2462eab0131271f.en: Reject all non-legal wording as meaningless
a2462eab0131271f.zh: 将所有非法律措辞作为无意义内容予以拒绝

32c91b08f65fae3b.en: Attribute an unexpressed demand to the author and forward it to an arbitrarily chosen authority
32c91b08f65fae3b.zh: 给作者安上未曾提出的要求，并随意转送某个机关

53645029b90627f3.en: Final day for notifying that the substance cannot be determined
53645029b90627f3.zh: 通知无法确定实质内容的截止日

e99dfbf263d93ec1.en: In the previous version, the text physically could not be read; here it is legible, but the subject cannot be determined. The grounds for notification differ, although the period is the same length.
e99dfbf263d93ec1.zh: 在前一版本中，文字本身无法辨读；本案文字清晰，但无法确定事项。通知的事由不同，尽管期限长度相同。

4ae0a694cefde429.en: Training condition: the entire text is legible, but it does not allow the substance of a proposal, application or complaint to be determined. There are no substantive annexes, references to earlier submissions or a separate identifiable demand. The conclusion is not based on emotional language or disagreement with the author.
4ae0a694cefde429.zh: 教学条件：全文均可辨读，但无法确定建议、申请或投诉的实质内容。没有实质性附件、对既往来函的引用或独立可辨明的要求。该结论并非基于情绪化表达或对作者观点的不赞同。

076e0a2a89ba0518.en: The surname and postal address are legible. The material was registered on {{registered}}. A notice must be prepared under the procedure established for this situation, rather than independently constructing the author's demand.
076e0a2a89ba0518.zh: 姓氏及邮政地址可辨读。材料于{{registered}}登记。应按本情形规定程序准备通知，而不是自行构造作者的要求。

3732703be3748886.en: Here the substance of the submission cannot be determined although the text is legible; a notice on the corresponding basis is needed, not a finding that every emotional letter is incomprehensible.
3732703be3748886.zh: 本案文字虽可辨读，却无法确定来函实质内容；应按相应事由通知，而不是认定任何情绪化信件都无法理解。

4da6892b1cbd440d.en: Every emotional or grammatically imperfect letter falls into this category.
4da6892b1cbd440d.zh: 任何情绪化或语法不完善的信件都属于这种情况。

de8b9943b92cf230.en: The officer must invent the author's demand and fulfil it.
de8b9943b92cf230.zh: 工作人员必须自行想象作者的要求并予以满足。

979a520d485d335e.en: Training continuation. A clarification arrives: the author identifies a specific refusal, organisation and desired action, and attaches a document.
979a520d485d335e.zh: 教学续篇。收到补充说明：作者明确了具体拒绝事项、机构及希望采取的行动，并附上文件。

ce74bb32cefbdfec.en: Consider the identifiable question on the clarified material, without carrying over the previous finding of uncertainty.
ce74bb32cefbdfec.zh: 根据补充材料办理可确定的问题，不沿用此前无法确定事项的结论。

de2036911aef6f86.en: Continue refusing because of the earlier letter.
de2036911aef6f86.zh: 因先前信件而继续拒绝。

23fa4e090e8747b2.en: Require another text, which must be drafted by a lawyer.
23fa4e090e8747b2.zh: 要求另交一份必须由律师撰写的文本。

2aaecec780901694.en: Notify that the substance cannot be determined, without confusing this basis with poor handwriting or non-professional wording.
2aaecec780901694.zh: 通知无法确定实质内容，不将这一事由与字迹欠佳或非专业表达混淆。

dc3fc417a0e4110a.en: The duty officer passes on a letter: the text is clearly printed, and a surname and address are present, but the material does not reveal what proposal, application or complaint has been submitted. There are no annexes or references to another case.
dc3fc417a0e4110a.zh: 值班人员转来一封信：打印文字清晰，有姓氏和地址，但无法从材料中确定提出的是何种建议、申请或投诉。没有附件，也没有引用其他案件。

2914bae45e0944da.en: Yes, the text is of good quality.

b680c6efd5d9ccee.en: This is not a case of physical illegibility.
b680c6efd5d9ccee.zh: 这不是文字本身无法辨读的情况。

f1995fc0c09d421e.en: No: the whole text was checked, and there is no reference to a specific decision, event or proposal.
f1995fc0c09d421e.zh: 不能：已检查全文，没有涉及具体决定、事件或建议。

4ac64a86c1b75b13.en: The materials establish that the substance cannot be determined.
4ac64a86c1b75b13.zh: 材料已明确无法确定实质内容。

5776638a7f7ea31c.en: Can the subject be identified after reading all the material?
5776638a7f7ea31c.zh: 阅读全部材料后能否确定事项？

0626c93c026b05ab.en: No, no attachments or clear reference to a previous case are specified.
0626c93c026b05ab.zh: 没有，未注明附件或对既往案件的明确引用。

0cc7195e82ec030d.en: We are not ignoring possible contextual information: none is present here.
0cc7195e82ec030d.zh: 我们没有忽视可能的背景信息：本案中并不存在此类信息。

4640c7d06ce63bbb.en: Is there a reference or annex that explains the question?
4640c7d06ce63bbb.zh: 是否有能说明问题的引用或附件？

73cc1d952840dcec.en: Yes, the surname and postal address are legibly stated.
73cc1d952840dcec.zh: 可以，姓氏及邮政地址填写清晰。

b9eeb58321879b82.en: The notice has an identified addressee.

3137d5f883239951.en: Can a notice be sent to the author?

8835477971173573.en: Prepare a notice under Article 11(4.1) that the substance of the submission cannot be determined, stating that a specific question may be set out.
8835477971173573.zh: 依据第11条第4.1款准备无法确定来函实质内容的通知，并说明可以提出具体问题。

55fa6d9e20388c38.en: Forward it to every authority on the basis of isolated random words in the text.
55fa6d9e20388c38.zh: 根据文中零散的随机词语转送所有机关。

9832f5358e3a9b06.en: Call the text illegible even though every word is clear.
9832f5358e3a9b06.zh: 尽管所有文字都清楚，仍称文本无法辨读。

281f84d3f74299c6.en: Every word is legible, but the question cannot be determined
281f84d3f74299c6.zh: 字字清楚，却无法确定问题

645b56cd75e7da84.en: Identifiable substance is not the same as professional style: an understandable everyday question cannot be rejected merely for its wording.
645b56cd75e7da84.zh: 实质内容可确定不等于文风专业：不能仅因措辞而拒绝清楚易懂的日常问题。

baaa0078b2d3a518.en: Any non-professional account has no identifiable substance.
baaa0078b2d3a518.zh: 任何非专业表述都没有可确定的实质内容。

5bb81c0a95f35e79.en: Assistant: “The author must write in legal terms, otherwise the question will not be considered.”
5bb81c0a95f35e79.zh: 助手：“作者必须使用法律术语，否则问题不予办理。”

c6260b38fce89c0c.en: Record the result of checking the original and annexes
c6260b38fce89c0c.zh: 记录检查原件及附件的结果

7651516d2dcfa659.en: Confirm that the surname and notification address are legible
7651516d2dcfa659.zh: 确认姓氏及通知地址可辨读

12fca2438344a4cd.en: Prepare a notice that the text cannot be read under the established procedure
12fca2438344a4cd.zh: 按规定程序准备无法辨读文本的通知

30e8bbe1e743abe3.en: Clearly explain that legible material may be sent, without demanding documents that are not required
30e8bbe1e743abe3.zh: 清楚说明可以提交可辨读材料，不要求未规定的文件

3d7ea6390493ba77.en: Retain the registration and confirmation that the notice was sent
3d7ea6390493ba77.zh: 保留登记及通知发送确认

999cd82d872a35ae.en: Invent the content and forward it on a guess
999cd82d872a35ae.zh: 编造内容并凭猜测转送

fc40d719f5d137cc.en: Delete the letter without notification despite a legible surname and address
fc40d719f5d137cc.zh: 在姓氏及地址可辨读的情况下，未经通知就删除信件

c20695136ab682d8.en: 59-ФЗ, Article 11, paragraphs 4 and 4.1: notification on the specified subject.
c20695136ab682d8.zh: 59-ФЗ第11条第4款及第4.1款：就指定事项进行通知。

05356f06d0e6cf3d.en: Final day for notifying that the text is illegible
05356f06d0e6cf3d.zh: 通知文本无法辨读的截止日

982b38d45dbfc17f.en: In the original anonymous report, the content was known but the author was unidentified. Here the author is known, but the content cannot be read: the action and deadline change.
982b38d45dbfc17f.zh: 原匿名报告的内容已知，但作者身份不明。本案作者已知，却无法辨读内容：所需行动与期限因此改变。

5841c189511505fa.en: In the fictional case, neither the original sheet nor the copy allows the content to be read. The surname and postal address are established and legible. There are no annexes enabling the question to be determined. This is not an anonymous letter: the problem is specifically the illegible text.
5841c189511505fa.zh: 在虚构案件中，原页及副本都无法辨读内容。姓氏及邮政地址已确定且可辨读。没有能够确定问题的附件。这不是匿名信：问题正是文本无法辨读。

43968067f9586a41.en: The letter was registered on {{registered}}. The exercise requires the deadline for notifying that the text cannot be read. There is no need to reconstruct the meaning by guesswork or address the letter to a presumed authority.
43968067f9586a41.zh: 信件于{{registered}}登记。本练习要求确定通知文本无法辨读的截止日期。无需凭猜测还原含义，也无需将信件转给推测的机关。

db1f5df1f2425f1f.en: When the content is established to be illegible but the surname and address are legible, the prescribed notice is required, not a substantive response or speculative forwarding.
db1f5df1f2425f1f.zh: 在已确认内容无法辨读而姓氏及地址清晰的情况下，应发送规定通知，而不是作实质回复或凭猜测转送。

409df5b910b92383.en: The presence of an address allows the officer to invent a subject for the letter and forward it at their discretion.
409df5b910b92383.zh: 只要有地址，工作人员就可以自行编造信件主题并酌情转送。

7f9e7c4eb3e12a9b.en: Any illegible text must be silently deleted together with its registration card.
7f9e7c4eb3e12a9b.zh: 任何无法辨读的文本都必须连同登记卡一起不作通知地删除。

53c6a465472bec13.en: Training continuation. The author sends a legible copy with a specific question and quotes the number of the previous notice.
53c6a465472bec13.zh: 教学续篇。作者寄来可辨读的副本，提出具体问题，并注明此前通知的编号。

6a46f2f53e013daf.en: Consider the newly received legible material according to its content and the applicable procedure; earlier illegibility does not prevent a new submission.
6a46f2f53e013daf.zh: 按新收到可辨读材料的内容及适用程序办理；此前无法辨读并不禁止新的来函。

fdbe1f23a3e2e57e.en: Return the copy because a notice has already been sent about the previous letter.
fdbe1f23a3e2e57e.zh: 因已就先前信件发送通知，而退回副本。

c2673cf287cc1981.en: Automatically grant any demand without reading the new copy.
c2673cf287cc1981.zh: 不阅读新副本就自动满足任何要求。

0f7c52109f1b8008.en: Notify the author that the text is illegible, without replacing the unavailable content with guesswork.
0f7c52109f1b8008.zh: 通知作者文本无法辨读，不用猜测替代无法获取的内容。

2779f82db4f6100c.en: The correspondence office has received a paper letter: the sheet got wet and the main text cannot be read. The surname and postal address are legible on the envelope and in the heading. The duty officer shows the original and a good-quality copy.
2779f82db4f6100c.zh: 文书处收到一封纸质信件：纸页被浸湿，正文无法辨读。信封及抬头的姓氏和邮政地址清晰。值班人员出示原件及高质量副本。

aed7b81b237e1c92.en: No: the original and copy were checked, and the text cannot be reconstructed from them.
aed7b81b237e1c92.zh: 不能：已检查原件和副本，无法据此还原文字。

418dd501f584c73a.en: The inability to read is established from the material, not merely from awkward handwriting.
418dd501f584c73a.zh: 无法辨读是根据材料确认的，而非仅因字迹难看。

eceb992c58c11317.en: The surname and postal address are legible.
eceb992c58c11317.zh: 姓氏及邮政地址清晰可辨。

9fb0d1026d4a58cc.en: There is an addressee for the notice.
9fb0d1026d4a58cc.zh: 存在可接收通知的对象。

edb7f92e84827ecb.en: What information about the author is known?

826d7f03a1737059.en: No, no additional material containing the question was received.
826d7f03a1737059.zh: 没有收到包含问题内容的补充材料。

9632ee913bfdd65f.en: The subject cannot be reconstructed from annexes.
9632ee913bfdd65f.zh: 无法从附件中还原事项。

405fe1f9267cccb4.en: No: nobody could read the content. There is no separate confirmation of danger.
405fe1f9267cccb4.zh: 没有：无人能辨读内容，也没有危险的独立确认信息。

9f3c69998d971e23.en: Do not attribute a presumed meaning to unknown text.
9f3c69998d971e23.zh: 不将推测含义强加给未知文本。

c09a7637692b27dd.en: Is there specific information about danger?
c09a7637692b27dd.zh: 是否有关于危险的具体信息？

506c21054f46e30b.en: You are dealing with written material, not an in-person meeting with its author. The duty officer reports only what is established from the envelope, text and annexes. Do not reconstruct unknown circumstances by guesswork.
506c21054f46e30b.zh: 您面对的是书面材料，而非作者本人来访。值班人员只报告从信封、文本及附件中查明的信息。不要凭猜测还原未知情况。

38f819139fa221ce.en: Prepare a notice to the author under Article 11(4) that the text is illegible; do not forward the material for consideration to a presumed competent authority.
38f819139fa221ce.zh: 依据第11条第4款向作者准备文本无法辨读的通知；不要将材料转送推测有管辖权的机关办理。

58712e132aafe631.en: Send the full sheet to every authority, asking them to guess the content.
58712e132aafe631.zh: 将整页发送给所有机关，请其猜测内容。

25ad2ec8884ed705.en: Treat the letter as anonymous even though the surname and address are legible.
25ad2ec8884ed705.zh: 尽管姓氏及地址可辨读，仍将信件视为匿名。

a2703c099e3fe9e5.en: The address is legible; the text is not

a985afe34c09e60b.en: In this case, a legible surname and address allow the prescribed notice to be sent within seven days of registration.
a985afe34c09e60b.zh: 本案中，清晰的姓氏及地址使得可以在登记之日起七日内发送规定通知。

ea476746b8673908.en: The inability to read cancels all organisational action.
ea476746b8673908.zh: 无法辨读意味着取消一切组织性行动。
